auth.signInDescription: Sign in to reach your account and the dashboard.
auth.signUpDescription: Create a new account with an email and password.
auth.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in.

errors.invalid_input: Check the email and password, then try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: Those sign-in details are not correct.
errors.signup_failed: We could not create the account. Try another email or again later.

notices.confirm_email: We sent a confirmation email. Open the link to activate the account.

shell.title: Dashboard
shell.forbiddenDescription: This area is for store administrators. If you think this is a mistake, contact the store owner.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The current state of the store, straight from the database.
overview.emptyCatalogDescription: Connect the G2Bulk provider and import games so they appear in the store.

providers.title: Providers and APIs
providers.description: Connect digital product suppliers and control pricing and syncing.

g2bulk.name: G2Bulk
g2bulk.summary: Supplier for game top-ups and digital cards. The API key is used on the server only.
g2bulk.apiKeyHelp: The key is stored in store settings and never shown again after saving. It is never sent to the browser.
g2bulk.apiKeyKeepHelp: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
g2bulk.markupHelp: Applied to the supplier cost to calculate your selling price on import.
g2bulk.importHint: Fetch the provider's game list and choose what to add to your store.
g2bulk.verified: The key is valid and the provider connection works.

errors.invalid_input: Check the values you entered, then try again.
errors.auth: The provider rejected the key. Check it — we do not retry automatically, to avoid an IP ban.
errors.rate_limit: We hit the provider's rate limit. Try again shortly.
errors.server: The provider service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.network: We could not reach the provider. Check connectivity and try again.
errors.contract: The provider replied in an unexpected shape. Nothing was changed.

import.title: Import G2Bulk games
import.description: Choose the games to add. Importing again refreshes prices instead of duplicating games.
import.loadFailed: We could not fetch the provider's game list.
import.publishLabel: Publish imported games in the store immediately
import.publishHelp: Turn this off if you want to review names and prices before customers see them.
import.emptyDescription: No games came back. Check your account with the provider.

catalog.title: Games and packages
catalog.description: Edit names, artwork, prices, and publication for what you imported or added.
catalog.emptyDescription: Import games from the G2Bulk provider and they appear here.

game.title: Game details
game.description: The Arabic name is what most customers read, so keep it accurate.
game.slugHint: Changing this changes the game's URL in the store.
game.isActiveHint: Turn off to hide it from customers without deleting it.
game.deleteConfirm: This deletes the game and all its packages. It cannot be undone.

offers.title: Packages
offers.description: Prices are in USD. Supplier cost is for your reference and is never shown to customers.
offers.pricingHint: Automatic refreshes on every import. Custom and fixed are left alone.
offers.emptyDescription: Import this game from the provider again to fetch its packages.

errors.invalid_input: Check the values you entered, then try again.
errors.slug_taken: That slug already belongs to another game.
errors.not_found: We could not find that game.
errors.unknown: We could not save. Please try again.

website.description: Control the homepage sections, social links, contact channels, and SEO.

sections.title: Homepage sections
sections.description: Reorder sections, switch them on, and set how many items each shows.

social.title: Social links
social.description: Shown in the footer, the links page, and the homepage social section.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: Used for the homepage title, description, and share image.

vouchers.description: Fetch the provider's categories and choose what to sell as gift cards and redeem codes.
vouchers.emptyDescription: No card categories came back from the provider.
vouchers.loadFailed: We could not fetch the provider's categories.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Search accounts, review balances, and correct one when you need to.
customers.emptyDescription: Accounts appear here after the first signup.
customers.adjustDescription: A positive amount adds balance, a negative one deducts. Every change is recorded in the transaction history.

errors.invalid_input: Check the amount and reason, then try again.
errors.negative_balance: That deduction would leave a negative balance.
errors.not_found: We could not find that account.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to adjust balances.
errors.unknown: We could not apply the adjustment. Please try again.

recharges.title: Wallet recharge requests
recharges.description: Review requests and credit balance once you have confirmed the payment arrived.
recharges.emptyDescription: Recharge requests appear here once customers create them.
recharges.creditAmountHint: Leave empty to credit the requested amount as is.
recharges.autoDescription: When on, balance is credited the moment a request is created, without your review.
recharges.autoWarning: Warning: manual methods do not verify that money arrived. With automatic crediting on, any customer can fund themselves without paying. Only enable this if you verify payments another way.
recharges.methodsDescription: What a customer sees on the add-balance page.
